draw_text_on_image: draw text on a numpy image array at specified x,y positions with configurable font size and color
draw_bbox_with_label: draw a bounding box rectangle on an image with an optional multi-line text label overlay
parse_pose_metainfo_from_dict: parse a pose dataset metainfo dict into keypoint names, skeleton links, flip pairs, and colors
parse_pose_metainfo_from_file: parse a pose dataset metainfo config file path into structured keypoint and skeleton metadata
review_parse_pose_metainfo: review the parse_pose_metainfo function to understand how keypoint flip indices and skeleton links are mapped
